decisions.decision: Three-tier chord_display chain: detect_chord → detect_partial_chord (up to 2 missing tones, jazz lead-sheet '(no X)' notation) → notes_as_intervals fallback
decisions.rationale: Empty-string fallback was hiding meaningful info; '+'-joined was non-music notation. Partial detection captures shell voicings.

decisions.decision: Padding-bottom percentage trick (14.4231% = 150/1040) for fretboard aspect lock instead of CSS aspect-ratio + contain
decisions.rationale: Engine-agnostic, works in every browser including older WebKit; aspect-ratio is Safari 15.4+ only and contain may not honor SVG layout in WebKit.

decisions.decision: .app-layout `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)` instead of relying on implicit auto column
decisions.rationale: Auto column = max-content; ActiveNotes' nowrap note-list could push the column past viewport, propagating to fretboard width. Architectural lock against any conditional content pushing layout.

decisions.decision: ActiveNotes strips trailing '(... in <Key>)' analysis suffix using `lastIndexOf(' (')` + regex check, NOT split on first ' ('
decisions.rationale: Splitting on first ' (' mangles partial chord names like 'Cmaj7(no 5)'. Last-pair-only stripping preserves them.

decisions.decision: PatternPanel.onMount no longer auto-starts the transport
decisions.rationale: Panel visibility persists in localStorage; auto-start fired on every fresh launch where user previously toggled the panel on, producing surprise click. User must press transport ▶ explicitly.

decisions.decision: Force metronome OFF in +page.svelte init effect after sync completes
decisions.rationale: Defends against any startup race where audio thread fires a beat crossing before UI's syncFromBackend completes.

decisions.decision: website-compat job is non-blocking via continue-on-error + token fallback to GITHUB_TOKEN
decisions.rationale: contrapunk-audio/website is private; default GITHUB_TOKEN can't clone it from PR contexts. Job still runs and surfaces failures but doesn't gate merge.
